# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_legendary_encounters.py". Edit le_rules.py or the builder and re-run.
# Province scope unless the name says otherwise. "owner" is the only country ever involved.

DA_LE_is_lich = {
	has_province_flag = DA_Verkal_koz_warning3
	has_province_modifier = DA_continous_Undeads
}

DA_LE_is_dragon = {
	has_province_modifier = DA_Dragon_raids
}

DA_LE_is_hunter = {
	has_province_flag = DA_Titanium_Vault_found_Hunter_of_the_deeps
	NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_Hunter_gone }
}

DA_LE_is_guest = {
	has_province_flag = DA_Setzunkhupa_guest_found
	NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_Setzunkhupa_guest_gone }
}

DA_LE_province_has_legend = {
	OR = {
		DA_LE_is_lich = yes
		DA_LE_is_dragon = yes
		DA_LE_is_hunter = yes
		DA_LE_is_guest = yes
	}
}

DA_LE_unlocked = {
	OR = {
		AND = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes owner = { has_country_flag = DA_can_duel_lich } }
		AND = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes owner = { has_country_flag = DA_can_duel_Dragon } }
		AND = { DA_LE_is_hunter = yes has_great_project = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 3 } }
		AND = { DA_LE_is_guest = yes always = yes }
	}
}

DA_LE_has_ward = {
	OR = {
		DA_LE_is_lich = yes
		DA_LE_is_hunter = yes
	}
}

DA_LE_weakness_known = {
	had_province_flag = { flag = DA_LE_scouting days = 180 }
}

DA_LE_scouts_out = {
	has_province_flag = DA_LE_scouting
	NOT = { had_province_flag = { flag = DA_LE_scouting days = 180 } }
}

DA_LE_contained = {
	OR = {
		has_province_modifier = DA_LE_contained_lich
		has_province_modifier = DA_LE_contained_dragon
	}
}

DA_LE_can_be_contained = {
	OR = {
		DA_LE_is_lich = yes
		DA_LE_is_dragon = yes
	}
}

# One fight only: if we do not kill it, it is gone.
DA_LE_flees = {
	OR = {
		DA_LE_is_hunter = yes
	}
}

# It can only be spoken to: no fight, no scouts, nothing to contain.
DA_LE_talk_only = {
	OR = {
		DA_LE_is_guest = yes
	}
}

DA_LE_stale = {
	had_province_flag = { flag = DA_LE_engaged days = 30 }
}

DA_LE_has_battle_mages = {
	owner = {
		OR = { has_estate = estate_mages has_country_flag = has_mages_estate_equiv }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = banned_magic }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = LF_mages_banned }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = mages_strike }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = block_magic_temp_modifier }
	}
}

DA_LE_ruler_can_lead = {
	owner = {
		OR = { ruler_has_personality = mage_personality ruler_has_personality = ancestor_mage_personality }
		has_regency = no
		NOT = { has_ruler_modifier = bd_wounded_ruler }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = banned_magic }
	}
}

# A school somebody on our side can cast this round.
DA_LE_school_ready = {
	NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_$school$ }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads
			owner = { OR = { has_ruler_flag = $school$_1 has_ruler_flag = $school$_2 has_ruler_flag = $school$_3 } }
		}
		AND = {
			DA_LE_has_battle_mages = yes
			owner = {
				OR = { has_country_flag = $school$_1 has_country_flag = $school$_2 has_country_flag = $school$_3 }
				check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 15 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: a legend this country could still deal with.
DA_LE_country_has_legend = {
	any_owned_province = {
		DA_LE_province_has_legend = yes
	}
}
